第8章 震惊的老狼-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

看着桌上的MP3，矮大紧心中涌起一抹不屑。

最后出于对音乐的尊重，他还是拿起耳机听起来。

几分钟后，矮大紧沉默了，他愣了几秒，再次按下播放键，又听了一遍。

还是沉默。

然后他又听了一遍，又一遍。

就这样过去了大半个小时，在听了十几次以后，矮大紧终于肯摘下耳机。

他把MP3轻轻放在桌上，长吁一口气。

没有赞叹，也没有惊讶，而是低眼从口袋里摸出烟盒，往嘴里咬了一根，不发一言。

半晌后，从他的嘴里蹦出来一句：“你们认识几年了？”

“四年。”

“就是从大学的时候开始谈的？”

“嗯。”

“好。”

又是沉默。

在这一刻，矮大紧仿佛读懂了对面的帅气男孩，虽然这是他们第一次见面。

都是曾经被抛弃的男孩，怎么能不懂？

魏沐：......

咱俩能一样？

你那是丑拒，我这是败给了现实！！

不对，是败给了资本。

唉...资本...

“呼~~”

矮大紧慢慢站起来，拍了拍他的肩膀。

“我去上个厕所，回来再商量怎么录制这首歌。”

冲他这表情，魏沐知道录歌稳了。

以矮大紧的音乐水平，知道这首歌的价值。

甚至换做其他音乐制作人都会花高价收了这首歌。

但是矮大紧没有那么做，因为他知道根本不可能。

人家星二代那是想红，根本不是奔着钱去的。

上厕所回来，矮大紧说起了现状。

“你想要在两个星期录完难度比较大，先不说修音的时间，就说你的唱歌水平，能不能通过我的审核。”

“你要是想玩票，我可以睁一只眼一只眼，但你要是想要做出一个好作品，那就别怪我挑你刺。”

“没事，老高你尽管搞，我挺得住。”

“好！！”

敲定事情，魏沐便起身离开。

他最近挺忙的，马上要毕业，各种屁事一堆，还要忙着搞毕业论文。

在这种情况下，还要抽出时间录歌。

这个时候就要感谢上辈子的练习生经历，跟那段时间比起来，这都算轻松的了。

Looking at the MP3 player on the table, Xiao Dajian felt a sense of disdain in his heart.

In the end, out of respect for the music, he picked up his headphones and listened.

A few minutes later, Xiao Dajeng was silent. He was stunned for a few seconds, pressed the play button again, and listened to it again.

Still silent.

Then he listened again, and again.

More than half an hour passed like this, and after listening to it more than a dozen times, Xiao Dajin was finally willing to take off his headphones.

He put the MP3 gently on the table and took a long breath.

There was no admiration or surprise, but he lowered his eyes and took out the cigarette case from his pocket, biting one into his mouth without saying a word.

After a while, a sentence popped out of his mouth: "How many years have you known each other?"

"Four years."

"We started talking about it when we were in college?"

"Yeah."

"Okay."

Silence again.

At this moment, Xiao Dajin seemed to understand the handsome boy opposite him, even though this was the first time they met.

They were all boys who had been abandoned, how could they not understand?

Wei Mu:......

Can we be the same?

You are being ugly, I have lost to reality!!

No, it was defeated by capital.

Alas...capital...

"Huh~~"

Xiao Dajin slowly stood up and patted his shoulder.

"I'm going to use the restroom and we'll discuss how to record this song when I come back."

Looking at his expression, Wei Mu knew that the song recording was safe.

With a short and tight musical level, I know the value of this song.

Even other music producers would have paid a high price for this song.

But Xiao Dagen didn't do that because he knew it was impossible.

The second generation of celebrities want to be famous, not for money at all.

After returning from the toilet, Gao Dajin talked about the current situation.

"It's quite difficult for you to finish recording in two weeks. Let's not talk about the time for editing. Let's talk about whether your singing level can pass my review."

"If you want to play tricks, I can turn a blind eye, but if you want to make a good work, then don't blame me for picking on you."

"It's okay, Lao Gao, you can do whatever you want, I can handle it."

"Okay!!"

After finalizing the matter, Wei Mu stood up and left.

He has been very busy recently. He is about to graduate and has a lot of shit to do. He is also busy working on his graduation thesis.

In this case, also find time to record songs.

At this time, I have to thank my experience as a trainee in my previous life. Compared with that time, this is considered easy.
